body:
hi，there
I'm planing to deploy self-hosting temporal, but my workflow executes 20 million times a day. 
In our usual business we use 100 database with sharding key，my question is does temporal support sharing database to support so much workflow executions.

comments.body:
Hello there. Temporal server doesn't support multiple databases at this time. 

Please join our community forum or slack channel (link in repo README) which are actually monitored by our dev success team, and they can help give suggestions for your use cases.

To add to the previous response:

Temporal does not officially support sharded databases. However, we have heard from community users who have successfully run Temporal on sharded MySQL by using `shard_id` as the sharding key for the mutable state and history tables. The schema design happens to have `shard_id` as the first column in the primary key for most core tables, which makes this approach feasible.

That said, **this is not officially supported or tested**, and users who go this route do so at their own risk.

For scaling guidance specific to your use case (20 million workflow executions/day), please join our community forum or Slack channel as suggested above.

title: Does temporal support sharing database?
